svg.text: ARABIA TO INDIA: THE GEOGRAPHICAL CONNECTION
Key places, 632–1206 CE • Approximate locations • No empire or modern political boundaries
Dashed connectors are teaching guides, not exact army routes. Ghurid campaigns also approached Multan from the west.
* Debal: approximate lower-Indus coastal area; the ancient site is debated. Ghor is a region, not a city dot.
Coastline: Natural Earth 1:110m, public domain. Equirectangular projection. Historical context: accompanying sourced notes.
